capabilities: show similar notes below the active note while writing
search the vault by meaning via a hotkey
run built-in local embedding models with no setup
connect to OpenAI-compatible APIs, OpenRouter, or Ollama
export similar-notes results to JSON for external agents
extras: Built-in default model downloads ~30MB on first run; the per-device index lives in IndexedDB and never syncs, so each device re-indexes from scratch. README warns large local models can crash mobile and details OpenRouter's Zero Data Retention setting for sensitive vaults. Further agent/CLI docs live in docs/agent-export.md.
problem: Obsidian's search matches keywords only, so it cannot find notes on the same topic written with different words.

relations.evidence: Use OpenAI embedding models or any OpenAI-compatible API
Connect to custom models via Ollama (desktop only)
OpenRouter offers embedding models from multiple vendors through one OpenAI-compatible API

summary: Semantic similarity plugin that surfaces notes related to the one you are writing and searches the vault by meaning using local or cloud embedding models.
